outcome.label: Paused
outcome.line: On hold for cleanup while the studio pushes other products. Not released.

lessons.text: The first Nookly apps for homeowners and contractors never shipped. Nookly OS narrows to one user: the owner of a trade business.

outcome.label: Parked
outcome.line: A prototype with day-by-day itineraries, maps, and sign-in. Work stopped in February 2025 before any release.

lessons.text: Maps, sign-in, and a backend are a lot of surface for a first test. A smaller slice would have reached people sooner.

outcome.label: Parked
outcome.line: An Android launcher prototype, never released. Launchers only run on Android and are hard to charge for.

lessons.text: A launcher is mostly platform plumbing, such as package install and removal events, not screens.

outcome.label: Archived
outcome.line: A prototype of podcasts you could join, with AI personas in the conversation. It did not ship, and work stopped in January 2024.

lessons.text: The landing page and domain went up before the app had its own name or app id, and the domain lapsed after work stopped.
